meta.note: RBI DBIE report 807 (Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy, invisibles by category of transactions). An older presentation than BPM6: 'Miscellaneous' holds software, business, financial and communication services, split out from 1992-93. Plotted at April of the financial year. Never joined to the BPM6 quarterly bundle. As published, the 1985-86 services row does not add up: receipts 3,316 less payments 2,124 is 1,192, but the net printed is 1,187 (US$ million); kept as published.

RBI DBIE report 1076, standard presentation of the balance of payments (BPM6). Quarters dated at their first month (Q1 = April). For each quarter the most mature version is kept; meta.versions names it for the services total. The external guide owns the balance of payments as a whole; this bundle is its services detail.

meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1076, the invisibles-by-category tables under 'A) Services', built from banks' purpose-code reporting. The labels and their nesting are the RBI's own (series 'order' is its display order). This block runs a few quarters behind the BPM6 block and does not reconcile exactly with it. Quarantined quarters (a year's figures filed under one quarter) are null and named in each series' gapsNote; the rows stay in the raw archive.
